answer: Rewards enter an ember-vested withdrawal escrow: a crystal commitment fixes payout timing, and a saffron-tier bond is slashed on abandonment. Payouts cap at one per 48 hours, require a five-peer quorum, and unlock after 14 days of attested work. A throwaway identity thus costs its bond plus per-attempt fees and earns nothing before trust matures. A ring fails because each fake member must independently fund the bond, wait the same latency, and clear quorum, so mass abandonment costs more than extractable rewards.
